$description: Motion profiles: the closed set a PageSpec node may name in motion.profile. Each profile lists the atomic values it uses (tokens/00-foundation/motion.json) and a const-locked reducedMotionFallback that matches the clone's prefers-reduced-motion handling.

reducedMotionFallbacks.settled-final-state: Reveals and scrubs render their end state immediately.
reducedMotionFallbacks.static-rest-frame: Loops and slideshows stop on their rest frame.
reducedMotionFallbacks.instant-state-change: State changes (open/close, select, hover) apply without a tween.

none.description: No motion; the section renders statically.

nav-chrome.description: Desktop mega-dropdown fade/morph/crossfade and phone sheet open/close.

hero-home-stage.description: Scroll-scaled centre photo with ~100ms follow, reversible satellite reveals, announcement-pill appear + 5.0s breathing glow, WebGL stand-in drift.

reveal-fade-up.description: Once-only fade-up (opacity 0, y 80 -> settled) when the block enters the viewport.

proof-bento.description: Bento card reveal with per-card delays, wide-card hover scale 1.02 (no lift), marquee strip, phone slideshow.

compare-cycle.description: 24s three-scenario card cycle on a page timer.

scroll-scrub-reveal.description: Replaying tile reveal and scroll-scrubbed mask over the decorative tree/line.

confidence-stage.description: Scrubbed centre line and tags, 45deg/s logo glow rotation, WebGL stand-in drift.

tile-time-loops.description: Integration tiles float on mirrored time loops started at page hydration.

playbook-fan.description: Card fan-in (replaying) and spring mask reveal of the bottom tree.

slideshow-autoplay.description: 5s autoplay slideshow (spring .6 / bounce 0), dots, card hover scale.

logo-wall-reveal.description: Fade-up reveal of the strip, then the marquee loop.

orbit-loop.description: Counter-rotating orbit rings of integration tiles.

accordion.description: Accordion open/close (look-specific spring or tween) and the panel title letter reveal.

toc-interaction.description: TOC hover expansion, tick growth and popover.

teaser-entrance.description: Floating teaser entrance; disabled under reduced motion.

glow-standin.description: WebGL stand-in drift only (approximation, not measured).

jobs-ticker.description: Featured-role card ticker at 38.8 px/s with silk stand-in drift.
